01 Profile

I am an Associate Professor in the Department of Computing at Universiti Teknologi PETRONAS, where I coordinate the postgraduate ODL programme. My work sits where wireless networking meets security and machine learning: medium access control for body-area sensing, privacy-aware auditing of data held in the cloud, and federated learning systems that stay accountable when their clients do not.

I completed my PhD at Universiti Teknologi Malaysia in 2017 on a 4.00 CGPA, leaving with both the Chancellor’s Gold Medal and the Best Student Award, then spent close to two years as a postdoctoral fellow at the University of Macau on hashing, encryption and public data auditing. The MAC protocols from that doctoral work — TraPy-MAC, EETP-MAC, CDASA-CSMA/CA — carry a granted Malaysian patent and five UTM copyrights.

Seventeen years of teaching across Pakistan, Saudi Arabia, Macau and Malaysia sit behind that: 109 refereed papers, two edited IGI Global volumes, nine book chapters, and doctoral, master’s and postdoctoral researchers supervised through to completion.

02 Research

Six lines of work

Each began with a network problem and grew a security or learning component; the earliest is still the most cited.

Medium access control for WBANs

Traffic-priority slot allocation, delay-aware superframe design and patient-data prioritisation for body sensors carrying emergency and periodic traffic at once.

TraPy-MAC · EETP-MAC · CDASA-CSMA/CA · DAASL-MAC

Cloud & IoT data auditing

Public auditing with parity authenticators, protection against invalid revocation of users, and privacy-aware verification for Intelligence-of-Things deployments.

IEEE IoT-J · IEEE T-CSS · Information Sciences

Federated learning & accountability

Auditable aggregation for Byzantine clients, staleness-aware client selection under bursty connectivity, and federated edge-AI inside consumer vehicles.

RollupFL · SAB-Select · FedFOMAML · Fed-IoMT-Block

Blockchain for IoE & healthcare

Smart contracts for Internet-of-Everything security, blockchain-backed clinical storage and threshold access control, and auditability frameworks for industrial IoT.

PRISM-IIOT · MediGuard · HOBNET

Applied machine learning in health

Low-dose CT denoising and reconstruction, brain-tumour segmentation, alternative-splicing prediction, and vocal biomarkers for Parkinson’s screening.

MPS-UNet · DeepSplice · Attention U-Net

Vehicular, UAV & underwater networks

Bio-inspired clustering and routing, prioritised delivery of safety messages, and energy-robust protocols for links that move or sit under water.

PDBFS · RUL-DBRS · memeHoc
